goal: Iske baad aap course ke mutabiq project idea chun sakenge, bata sakenge woh kaun se concepts use karta hai, uska scope chhota rakh sakenge, aur use menu, struct, functions aur file mein tor sakenge.
warmup: Cricket match se pehle team trophy kharidne se shuru nahi karti. Pehle team chunti hai, phir tay karti hai kaun batting karega aur kaun bowling, phir khelti hai. Project bhi aisa hi hai. Chhota idea chunein jo aap khatam kar saken, kaam ko chhote jobs mein baantein, aur har job ek function ko dein. Project grade ka 15% hai, is liye pehle se plan karna faida deta hai.
definition: Acha PF project course ke zyada se zyada concepts use karta hai: menus (loops aur switch), arrays ya structures, functions, file handling, aur saaf input validation. Scope ka matlab hai project kitna bara hai. Scope control karne ka matlab hai project ko itna chhota rakhna ke aap use khatam kar saken, test kar saken aur har line samjha saken. Breaking down ka matlab hai project ko hisson mein baantna: ek record ke liye ek struct, har menu feature ke liye ek function, aur data save karne ke liye ek file.
howItWorks: Idea table se shuru karein. Har idea wahi course concepts ek mukhtalif kahani mein milata hai. Woh chunein jo aap ko dilchasp lage, kyunke aap use class ke samne samjhayenge. Phir feature list saade alfaaz mein likhein: Library ke liye yeh hai book add karna, saari books dikhana, title se search, book issue karna, book return karna, save aur load. Har feature menu ka ek case aur ek function ban jata hai. Data ek struct (masalan Book) aur us struct ka array ban jata hai. Aakhir mein file jorein taake program band hone ke baad bhi data rahe. Scope kaise control karein: pehle chhota working version mukammal karein (sirf add aur show wala menu), phir ek ek feature jorein aur har ke baad test karein. Das features se shuru na karein. Teams yeh yaqeeni banayein ke har member kisi bhi hisse ko samjha sakta ho. Files mein kaise todein: is course ke liye ek hi .cpp file kaafi hai, magar tarteeb saaf rakhein: includes, struct, constants, function prototypes, main, phir function definitions.
